cells.gaps: SIGMAT was in testing in November 2024; in October 2026 one ECOWAS MP listed Sierra Leone among countries implementing it while the delegation urged it to advance implementation. No source shows transit data exchanged in service.
cells.note: The WTO says Sierra Leone runs the Electronic Single Window it introduced in 2020, and the NRA says ASYCUDA World connects several agencies, so stage 4. SIGMAT is still being implemented, not shown exchanging data, so not stage 5.
